_doc: Model registry: the current model of each tier, per harness. Read by the model router (protocols/model-routing.md), by kcc-run for direct agent runs, and by `kcc models` (--check probes every pinned id against the installed harness; --refresh also reports what each alias resolves to, so a newer generation is noticed). sync-adapters pins the same ids into the generated agent files; `kcc models --check` fails when the two disagree. Costs are deliberately absent: look them up when a budget matters, do not trust a copy.

tiers.strong: Hard reasoning: novel domains, architecture trade-offs, security review, failing-review rework.
tiers.balanced: Interrogation, specs, plans, verification, critique; the default for writing.
tiers.fast: Execution per an approved plan: implementation, scaffolds, docs, meta-agents.
tiers.deep: DeepThinking: the most capable model at xhigh/max effort for a few named, bounded analysis tasks, only after the human has seen the cost (protocols/deep-thinking.md). Never a default and never chosen by the router.

tier_cost_observed.source: one `claude -p --output-format json` probe per model; costUSD of a call that only writes the session context to cache
tier_cost_observed.note: Measured on Claude Code 2.1.283, which prints `unrecognized_model` for both 5.5 ids: the identical $8/M is that build's fallback price for an unknown model (it equals the Opus 5.5 one-hour cache-write rate), not the list price. List prices (2026-10): Haiku 5.5 $0.10 in / $0.50 out, Sonnet 5.5 $2 / $10, Opus 5.5 $4 / $20, Fable 5.1 $10 / $50 per MTok. Re-probe on a Claude Code build that knows the ids; until then every reported run cost is an estimate. The implementer runs on balanced for quality (round 9: the fast tier wrote weaker code), not for price.

deep_cost_observed.source: two `claude -p --model claude-fable-5-1 --effort max` probes, costUSD from the JSON result
deep_cost_observed.note: A one-word reply cost $0.82 (41k tokens of session context written to cache). A 400-word reply at max effort produced 10.7k output tokens (mostly thinking) and cost $0.75. Look prices up before relying on these; they are a floor that tells a human the order of magnitude.

claude._note: Aliases float with the installed Claude Code build and may resolve to an older generation (haiku -> Haiku 4.5, which has no auto mode); always pin the id.
